summary: Tested the YOU! tile that replaces Victoria Black Goddess. Backend prompt neutralization: 12/12 pytest pass, no paid calls. Frontend Playwright run with POST /api/dressing-room/generate mocked: every requested check passes. Grid order is Victoria Black, YOU!, Community OC, Wargirl, Binary, Vanessa, Harmony, Evil Victoria, VixenVictoria, Veronica, with no Goddess tile. The YOU! tile has a pink border and a pink/cyan gradient, the subtitle and the '📸 Use your own photo' badge. No horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390. /dressing-room/you shows the right heading, hint, button and empty-preview copy. Try Nexus is hidden and the Nexus Media Library button is present. Generate is disabled until a photo is uploaded and enabled after. Captured payloads: you -> character_id 'you', name 'YOU!', save_as_base false, base64 sent. community_oc -> save_as_base true. The old /dressing-room/victoria_black_goddess link still opens that room. The Pairs second-character list and the Media Library filter both leave out YOU! and Community OC. SEO HTML mentions YOU! and has no 'Goddess'.

minor.issue: Found by code review, not run (it needs a paid generation). The Pairs section is shown in the YOU! room. generate_pairs_image_blended only reads get_base_image(character_id) and ignores reference_image_base64. Because YOU! photos are never saved (save_as_base false), YOU! + any second character will always fail with 400 'No base image found for YOU!'.

The 'never saved' promise is enforced only in the frontend. If a client sends character_id='you' with save_as_base=true, the backend saves base_images/you.png, and later requests then fall back to that stored photo (Priority 3). The backend should refuse to save when character_id=='you'.

integration_issues.issue: The second-character picker is shown, but generating will fail on the backend (see the backend minor issue). Either hide Pairs for isYou or have the backend use the uploaded base64 for char1.

issues: Helper text still gives the example 'a Black woman keeps her exact face and hair'. This is minor, but neutral wording would fit the YOU! room better.

action_items: Handle Pairs mode for YOU!: hide the Pairs section when selectedCharacter.isYou, or make generate_pairs_image_blended use reference_image_base64 for char1
Backend: force save_as_base False (and skip the stored-base fallback) when character_id=='you'

In DressingRoom.jsx the DR_LOOKUP/DR_CHARACTERS definitions sit between import statements (line 21 imports after the consts). It works, but it is unconventional.
